title: The Ancestral Tree Maximum Energy Path
statement:
A path in a tree is a sequence of nodes where each pair of adjacent nodes has an edge connecting them. A node can only appear in the sequence at most once.
The path sum of a path is the sum of the node's values in the path.

You are given an undirected tree with V nodes numbered 1 to V, where the i-th node has an integer value Val_i.
Find the maximum path sum of any non-empty path in the tree.
inputFormat:
First line: Integer V.
Second line: V space-separated integers representing node values Val_1 to Val_V.
Next V - 1 lines: Two integers u and v indicating an edge.
